svg.title: Lord of Peace Restored: Two of Swords · Moon in Libra · Chokmah (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Moon above the painting and Libra below, as Book T places them: "At the top and bottom of the card are two small daggers, supporting respectively the symbol [site: Moon] thus, and Libra representing the Decanate." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791653400184-vop82hpec2a.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
